nodes.name: Create revision project
nodes.notes: Creates the project WITHOUT images (fast). Images are uploaded in batches by the next two nodes to stay under the serverless timeout.

nodes.name: Upload one image
nodes.notes: Uploads exactly ONE image as multipart/form-data binary (field 'images', from binary property 'data'), then returns to Loop Over Images for the next. Keep sequential — never enable parallel/concurrency.

nodes.name: Loop Over Images
nodes.notes: Loops one image at a time. Output 'loop' -> Upload image batch -> back here. Output 'done' -> Zoho branch.
